crossRefs.note: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…
The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not…

translations.web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
translations.bsb: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
translations.kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
translations.asv: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.
